name: Weather Escalation Contact
description: One rung of the severe-weather human escalation ladder (TENANT-side, admin-configured). When a top-severity notice stays unacknowledged past the configured window, the hourly escalation job (src/tenant/escalation.py) notifies enabled contacts one at a time in priority order via whichever channels are composed and configured (push for linked users, email, SMS when a gateway exists; voice is a documented pluggable seam). A contact's tokened acknowledge link records into the Weather Notice Delivery ledger and stops the ladder. No rows configured means the ladder is a silent no-op.

fields.label: Priority (1 = first)
fields.description: Ladder order - lower numbers are notified first

fields.label: User (for push)
fields.description: Optional: a linked user receives the escalation as a push notification via the comms module

fields.label: Phone
fields.description: Used for SMS when an SMS gateway is configured (and for a voice channel if one is ever plugged in)

fields.label: Watch Location Scope (Grid Key)
fields.description: Optional: restrict this contact to one 0.25 degree grid cell; empty means the whole site
